answer: Latent coordination fingerprinting. Agents that repeatedly act in lockstep (same timing, same rare sequences) leave a statistical trail; once flagged, their shared origin is inferred and future actions are rate-limited at the wharf of entry. Each identity must then sustain genuinely independent behavior, costing attackers continuous diversification effort. A ferrous ledger records these correlations permanently, and honest agents harbor no penalty since their patterns diverge naturally.
